*Huge Opportunity for Educational Influencers/Creators with 100k+ followers*
I want to partner with a small elite group of educational creators to help you earn more from your audience.
Why? --> In May, Skool added 1.25M new users to our 27M base. And every month there are more.

So --> We need great communities to send them to.

Apply here: [www.SkoolPlatinum.com](www.SkoolPlatinum.com)

1\) Set up 2\) Launch to your warm audience 3\) Manage in minimal time 4\) Promote on-going.

You'll also get:

2\) We will promote you to our to 27M+ users
3\) We will run paid ads to your community—AFTER you launch to your own audience & follow our on-going promotion tactics.

To qualify:
[ul][li]100k+ total followers[li]Educational creator[li]All-in on Skool[li]Promote your community \(duh\)

Let the games begin,
Hormozi

metadata.description: Learn to think like a problem solver, design AI automation solutions, and get paid for it.
metadata.lpDescription:
I built an AI automation agency from zero to over $1 million per year.

Now I'm teaching you how to do it too. Starting from zero.

The secret?

Clients on long-term contracts paying $5,000 - $20,000 per month.

Nobody on YouTube teaches you how to do that, because they haven't done it. I have.

Here's the process:
[ol:1][li]AI partner model — The complete business model behind a million-dollar agency.[li]Learn Claude Code – We teach you from beginner to expert with hands-on projects[li]Build your portfolio — You walk away with real work to show clients.[li]Get your first client — Take what you've built and land paying clients. Unlocks after 30 days.[li]Scale your business — Business formation and systems. Unlocks after 90 days.

What You Get Inside
• Courses with step-by-step instructions
• 3 online conferences per year
• One annual event per year
• Unlimited FREE tech support
• Weekly Q&As with Nate
• Job opportunities

Refund policy: Annual members can request a refund within 7 days. For monthly members, all sales are final.
